policy: Dynamic Mister clause model: clause price always moves with the player's current market value. 50% is the compulsory minimum, then 100%, 150%, 200% and so on. Opportunity uses real match evidence, current VM momentum, role/news context, affordability and an after-purchase break-even estimate.
